content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IISER Pune Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IISER Pune Recruitment 2026 is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Senior Project Associate and Project Assistant in the IISER Pune Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant post, candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Physics, Chemistry, or Materials Science.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The Senior Project Associate will receive a salary of Rs. 57,000 plus 30% House Rent Allowance per month.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for the posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an online interview via Zoom, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for this recruitment by sending their applications via email.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.
